name: FajaBooks
description: Uruguayan online bookstore selling new and used books and book packs, with cart at /carrito. States delivery across Uruguay and in-person pickup.
description_es: Librería en línea uruguaya de libros nuevos y usados y packs, con carrito propio. Informa entrega en todo Uruguay y retiro en persona.

ships_to.notes: Store states delivery in all of Uruguay; Montevideo by zone, interior via DAC

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup in person; for interior orders at a DAC branch, per the store homepage

shopping_notes: Shipping cost is calculated at checkout; some items marked free shipping. No separate shipping page; details are on the homepage.

sources.supports: delivery in all of Uruguay, DAC for interior, pickup, cart
